product.title: Venice In a Day: Basilica San Marco, Doges Palace & Gondola ride

description.text: Ideal for first-time visitors, this full-day tour of Venice checks off all the most-important attractions. Stroll across the Rialto Bridge and browse the lively Rialto fish market, then hop aboard a traditional gondola for a romantic cruise along the Grand Canal. Stops include Ponte di Rialto, Mercato di Rialto, Canal Grande, Basilica di San Marco, Doge's Palace. Finally, visit St. Mark's Basilica and enjoy skip-the-line entrance to the grandiose Doge's Palace. Ideal for visitors basing in Venice who want a guided city experience without coordinating vaporetto routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Ponte di Rialto, Mercato di Rialto, Canal Grande, Basilica di San Marco that define this Venice sightseeing experience, with a guide handling vaporetto connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
